comment: Independent wizard-mode ^V answered with a dungeon name whose branch is not placed yet. dungeon.c lev_by_name() finds no level called "fort ludios" and calls find_branch(), which matches the branch whose end2 is Fort Ludios. fixup_level_locations() left that branch's end1.dnum at the bogus n_dgns, so ledger_no(&br->end1) reads svd.dungeons[n_dgns].ledger_start, a zeroed unused slot, and returns end1.dlevel alone; lev_by_name() takes that ledger as the Dungeons of Doom level to arrive on. ':' and ^O show the arrival level.
